title: Path coverage exemptions
description: Flow nodes and sequence flows that the scenarios of a project need not visit, each with a reason (docs/adr/0005-scenario-format.md, 'Path coverage'). Everything not listed here must be visited by some scenario of the project.

process.description: Process id; omit when the element id is unique in the project.

element.description: Id of the flow node or sequence flow.

reason.description: Why the element cannot or need not be visited.
